card.text: Explore Greip, a moon of Saturn, through its lightcurve-constrained shape approximation.

introduction.text: Greip’s preferred rotation period is about 12.75 hours, with an approximately 19-hour alternative still possible. This ellipsoid illustrates a minimum elongation with assumed depth and orientation. The grid marks unmapped terrain.

model.title: Light-curve shape approximation
model.summary: Approximate ellipsoid adopting minimum equatorial ratio 1.18:1 under uniform reflectivity. Equal short axes and volume scaling are assumed. Orientation and phase are illustrative. The grid marks unmapped terrain.
